Proposed execution boundary: models produce versioned research/proposed code; deterministic reviewed engine/risk owns order intent, a single writer/account, stable client IDs, journal, stale-data checks, risk limits, reconciliation before retry, shutdown and independent alerts. Trading request budget reserves risk/reconciliation; market-data budgets separate. Streaming/data arithmetic off model hot path; no MCP unrestricted broker tool in generic research workers.

Memory compounding is reviewed research lessons/retrieval relevance and immutable experiment artifacts. It must not auto-promote live policies. Current ai-memory source supports auto_improve.require_approval=true and scheduler.enabled=false; local zero-LLM profile has not been changed. LangGraph strict deserialization and durable checkpointer need explicit acceptance; DeerFlow already depends on LangGraph, so extra orchestrator may duplicate ownership.
